t: This is Trevor Street, in Westminster. It takes its name from Sir John Trevor, a Welsh lawyer and politician. He was Speaker of the House of Commons twice, from 1685 to 1687 and from 1689 to 1695, and Master of the Rolls. His second term as Speaker ended over a bribery allegation, and he was expelled from the House soon after. Harry Fane, who lived here, is also linked to the street.
